title: Introduce Yourself
subtitle: Make a great first impression
description: Practice the most common phrases for meeting someone new. From sharing your name to talking about what you do, these sentences will help you feel confident at any first encounter.
tip: Smile and slow down slightly on your name — people remember you better when you give them a moment to catch it.
phrases: Hi, my name is Alex and it's great to meet you.
I'm originally from Brazil, but I've been living here for three years.
I work as a software developer at a small tech company.
I've been learning English for about two years now.
Nice to meet you — what do you do for a living?
I actually moved here to study at the university.
This is my first time at one of these events.
Feel free to reach out if you ever want to practice together.
